pages.title: Sort Right
pages.creator: Vagstech
pages.description: Sort Right asks you to arrange colored bottles in the order shown by a reference pattern. Later stages hide the target once placement begins, testing your memory. Use CHECK to learn how many bottles are correct and adjust the arrangement with fewer guesses.

pages.title: Drople
pages.creator: Zadzi
pages.description: Drople sends a ball down 75 tall stages toward an altar at the bottom. Avoid spikes, saws, water, and other hazards while racing for time-based stars. Checkpoints help you recover, but deaths add time and hidden coins offer another objective off the safer route.

pages.title: Word Stars
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Word Stars challenges you to build words from the letters scattered across a board. Fill the empty spaces with the answers that fit and complete each puzzle's word set. Use hints when a missing combination is keeping you from moving into the next level.

pages.title: Racing Ball Adventure
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Racing Ball Adventure sends a sphere down huge slopes through plains, canyons, and cliffside terrain. Steer the rolling ball at speed while searching for a mystical crystal. Complete the low-poly adventure's journey to help prevent the disaster threatening its world.

pages.title: 99 Balls
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: 99 Balls mixes ball launching with numbered targets in a three-dimensional endless challenge. Drag backward to aim, then release to hit cylinders as many times as their numbers require. Clear them before they reach the bottom and collect stars for new ball skins.

pages.title: Crazy Tunnel
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Crazy Tunnel gives you a first-person ride through a tunnel at high speed. Move the mouse to navigate its changing route and keep the journey going. Push for a longer distance as the fast-moving course tests how quickly you can adjust your direction.

pages.title: The Zombie House
pages.creator: Nabil Smriti
pages.description: The Zombie House challenges you to defend a home from repeated undead attacks. Shoot zombies to collect coins and ability drops, then improve the character and house. Keep strengthening the defense as each level sends stronger enemies toward your position.

pages.title: Hoard Master Online
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Hoard Master Online puts a roaming black hole under your control. Slide it around to swallow objects and turn the haul into money. Spend the proceeds on stronger holes and expanded territory as you develop the game's upgrade-and-construction operation.

pages.title: Sort Works: Nuts & Order
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Sort Works: Nuts & Order asks you to group colored nuts onto matching bolts. Lift a bolt's top nut and move it onto the same color or an empty bolt. Plan the transfer order until every stack is sorted by color.

pages.title: Stick Rope Hero
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Stick Rope Hero lets you explore a city as a rope-swinging stickman. Use the character's rope ability to travel through the open environment and reach action tasks. Complete the available challenges while making your way around the sandbox city's streets and buildings.

pages.title: Find It Fast
pages.creator: POKET GEAR
pages.description: Find It Fast gives you busy scenes containing a list of hidden objects. Study the requested items and tap each one when you locate it in the picture. Finish the search tasks before time expires to unlock additional maps and continue the scavenger hunt.

pages.title: Hole Digger
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hole Digger sends you underground with a shovel to search for valuable resources. Sell what you mine and spend the income on tool improvements and stronger digging skills. Keep descending toward deeper treasures while upgrading how quickly you can remove the ground.

pages.title: Link Flow
pages.creator: mustapha quamar
pages.description: Link Flow challenges you to reproduce geometric patterns by connecting dots with continuous lines. Study the reference and plan how the points should join before placing the paths. Work through increasingly complicated designs as the puzzle asks for more careful connections.

pages.title: Call of the Jungle! Animal Evolution
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Call of the Jungle! Animal Evolution sends a growing animal along a food-collecting course. Feed it meat to help it evolve, gather crystals, and select useful gates for more points. Avoid traps as you work toward reaching the end with a stronger beast.

pages.title: Sky Block Bounce
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Sky Block Bounce asks you to jump between floating blocks and reach a teleporter. Watch how often each surface can be used, since some disappear after one landing while others last longer. Plan a route that preserves the blocks needed for the final jumps.

pages.title: The Shape
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: The Shape gives you reference figures to recreate with geometric pieces. Move the shapes into positions that match the target design and adjust the arrangement until it fits. Complete the successive visual puzzles by comparing your construction with the example shown.

pages.title: Christmas N Tiles
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas N Tiles challenges you to collect festive tiles into a limited bottom tray. Remove them by completing sets of three identical pictures. Choose the order carefully so unmatched selections do not use all the available spaces before the board is cleared.

pages.title: Daily Sudoku
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Daily Sudoku asks you to fill a number grid using logical deductions from the supplied clues. Place digits one through nine without repeating them in a row, column, or three-by-three square. Complete every empty cell while keeping all three grouping rules satisfied.

pages.title: Kick Zombie Voodoo
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Kick Zombie Voodoo gives you an arsenal for attacking a zombie target. Try weapons such as guns, grenades, lasers, and saws to inflict damage. Collect coins and unlock or improve equipment as you experiment with the different attacks available to use.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Gold
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Gold has you aim colored balls into clusters suspended overhead. Choose a trajectory that clears bubbles or disconnects a larger group from the ceiling. Work through the levels by looking for shots that remove more of the arrangement at once.

pages.title: Terror Camp Takedown
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Terror Camp Takedown puts you in a desert combat mission against an enemy training camp. Move through the area and shoot the opposing fighters to shut down the operation. Switch among your weapons as you work to clear the camp before another attack is planned.

pages.title: Nerd Fight
pages.creator: Melon Gaming
pages.description: Nerd Fight is a tap-controlled RPG about building a team to battle bullies. Push through Campaign stages or race the clock in Time Attack. Collect eight nerd characters and 32 skins while improving the army you bring into the next confrontation.

pages.title: Flip Cube
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: Flip Cube lets you aim and drop numbered cubes into a physics-based merge puzzle. Match equal values to create larger numbers as the pieces bounce and flip together. Keep combining the cubes to increase their values and raise the score from your drops.

pages.title: Funny Angela Haircut
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Angela Haircut gives you salon tools for changing Angela's hair. Cut, curl, dry, recolor, or regrow sections using the different styling options. Finish the makeover by choosing a fashionable outfit that complements the hairstyle you have created for her.

pages.title: Square Monsters
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Square Monsters challenges you to bring every monster into a portal. Move and jump through the platform puzzles while keeping the characters away from spikes. Complete the group's escape route across twenty-four stages, making sure no monster is left outside a teleporter.

pages.title: Real Flying Truck Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Real Flying Truck Simulator 3D combines driving with flying vehicles in a futuristic city. Use the movement controls to guide the truck through the urban setting and into the sky. Explore the city's higher routes as you practice handling a vehicle beyond ordinary road driving.

pages.title: Poppy Dungeons
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Poppy Dungeons follows the last survivor of a team sent after a dangerous purple monster. Guide the character through an underground area occupied by armed soldiers. Keep moving away from gunfire and pursuit while searching for a route out of the dungeon.

pages.title: 3 Pandas 2. Night
pages.creator: FlashTeam
pages.description: 3 Pandas 2. Night follows three pandas trying to survive an island after dark. Move the group, operate switches, climb ladders, and activate mechanisms along the route. Use each panda's special ability to overcome obstacles that require the trio to work together.

pages.title: She is so Different!
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: She is so Different! helps an actress prepare for three sides of her routine. Begin with facial care and sportswear for the gym, then create makeup for shopping. Finish with an evening hairstyle, brighter cosmetics, and a dress for the red carpet.

pages.title: Squid Mission Hunter Online
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Squid Mission Hunter Online puts you in charge of catching participants who escaped the games. Aim a harpoon and fire at the fleeing characters, bringing them back to the waiting ship. Line up each shot to complete the hunter's capture objective.

pages.title: Space Hidden Alphawords
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Space Hidden Alphawords combines a hidden-letter search with astronomy vocabulary. Examine space-themed scenes to locate the alphabet characters needed for each word. Collect the hidden letters and complete the terms as you continue through the educational search puzzles.

pages.title: Target
pages.creator: nau.studio
pages.description: Target challenges you to fire at a moving mark in a minimalist shooting puzzle. Wait for an opening and send the shot toward the target. Complete each stage to advance as the movement and timing become more difficult in later levels.

pages.title: Halloween Find the Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Halloween Find the Differences gives you ten pairs of spooky pictures to compare. Mark the altered details and use the circles around found differences to track your progress. Click carefully, since three incorrect selections end the current attempt at the search.

pages.title: Fish Story
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Fish Story is an underwater match-three journey hosted by Poseidon. Swap sea creatures into groups of at least three and create larger combinations for boosters. Work through more than seven hundred stages while trying to earn full stars from each puzzle.

pages.title: Candy Land Swipe Fantasy Match 3
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Candy Land Swipe Fantasy Match 3 asks you to combine matching sweets across a fantasy-themed puzzle board. Make groups of three or more and use earned boosters to help clear difficult sections. Continue through levels that grow harder as the candy-matching journey progresses.

pages.title: Ladder Climber
pages.creator: Super Apps
pages.description: Ladder Climber tests how well you can coordinate climbing with changing hand positions. Use one button to climb and the other to swap hands as the route demands. Keep choosing the correct action quickly enough to progress farther up the ladder.

pages.title: Coins Transporter Monster Truck
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Coins Transporter Monster Truck asks you to finish rough driving stages while keeping cargo aboard. Balance the truck over the route and preserve at least one coin in its bed. Reach the finish with a remaining coin to meet the level's transport requirement.

pages.title: Catch The Apple
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Catch The Apple guides a hedgehog through physics puzzles on a search for food. Use the objects in each stage to reach every apple, while collecting stars when possible. Build a strong star haul to unlock more levels for the hungry hedgehog.

pages.title: Penguin Diner
pages.creator: 2dplay.com
pages.description: Penguin Diner follows Penny earning money after becoming stranded during an Antarctic trip. Seat customers, take orders, serve their meals, and collect payment when they leave. Keep the penguins happy for better tips as Penny saves enough to return to her family.

pages.title: Extreme Golf
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Extreme Golf gives you a limited supply of balls for landing shots in the hole. Hold to prepare a shot and release to strike it, earning a point for a successful finish. Misses cost a ball, so accurate attempts keep the scoring run going.

pages.title: Toddler Coloring Game
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Toddler Coloring Game lets you draw animals in guided steps and fill them with color. Finish a picture to see the character come alive in an animated dance. Continue through different animals, including a crocodile and a fox, as their drawings turn into performances.

pages.title: Paper Flick
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Paper Flick turns an office wastebasket into a target for paper-ball throws. Aim and flick the crumpled paper toward the bin, adjusting your attempt for the chosen challenge. Try easy, medium, or hard difficulty as you practice getting the ball into the basket.

pages.title: Draw Missing Part
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Draw Missing Part gives you incomplete pictures and asks you to identify what is absent. Study the object, work out the missing detail, and draw it with the mouse. Complete the image to solve the visual riddle and continue to another puzzle.

pages.title: Jelly Shift
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Jelly Shift challenges you to reshape a moving jelly object for the openings ahead. Slide up or down to change its height and width until it fits the approaching obstacle. Keep adjusting the form correctly to carry the jelly through to its destination.

pages.title: Sand Balls 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Sand Balls 2 asks you to dig channels through sand so a group of balls can reach a truck. Swipe or drag to clear a route beneath them. Plan the tunnel's shape so the falling balls roll into the vehicle's cargo area.

pages.title: Wild Dino Transport Simulator
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Wild Dino Transport Simulator puts a dinosaur inside a transport truck's cage for a driving job. Guide the vehicle along its route and bring the animal to the unloading point. Complete the delivery by moving the caged dinosaur to its required destination.

pages.title: Sea World Match 3
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Sea World Match 3 fills a grid with different marine creatures to match. Look for groups of identical sea animals and bring them together to remove pieces from the field. Keep finding useful combinations as the underwater matching board changes after each clear.

pages.title: Internet Fashionista Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Internet Fashionista Dress Up lets Dolce model the outfits you create. Browse her fashion choices and combine pieces into looks inspired by the online style world. Help the fashionista prepare a complete appearance as she shares her clothing and beauty interests.

pages.title: FZ Color Ball
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: FZ Color Ball challenges you to help a ball jump past obstacles. Use mouse clicks or touch inputs to time its movement through the route. Watch the barriers ahead and keep the ball's jumps aligned with the openings available to it.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunts Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Monster Truck Stunts Driving Simulator gives you stunt-driving challenges involving large-wheeled vehicles and difficult tracks. Accelerate through the course, brake for tricky sections, and control the vehicle during its maneuvers. Work through the driving situations to complete the stunt route.

pages.title: Chroma Balls
pages.creator: poncle
pages.description: Chroma Balls asks you to aim bouncing balls at bricks until their durability falls to zero. Hold and move to choose a useful angle for the shot. Clear the blocks quickly enough to keep any of them from reaching the bottom of the screen.

pages.title: Draw The Path
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Draw The Path asks you to create a route for a moving character. Use the mouse to build the path and collect coins and candy along the way. Spend the earned coins to unlock additional characters for another run through the drawing challenge.

pages.title: My Dream Hospital
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: My Dream Hospital puts you in charge of treating injured patients. Use the clinic's tools to work through the medical activities, including closing wounds. Finish the current patient's treatment before moving to the next person needing care in the hospital.

pages.title: LA Shark
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: LA Shark puts you in control of a hungry shark hunting people around Los Angeles. Move through the water toward prey and dive underwater with the action button. Keep guiding the shark around the area as you continue its feeding adventure.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Cute Unicorn Jigsaw offers twelve unicorn pictures to rebuild at three difficulties. Choose twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces, then fit them into the correct positions. Use the image details to restore the complete fantasy scene one section at a time.

pages.title: Double runner
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Double runner gives two players separate jump controls on the same device. Dodge obstacles, gather coins, and reach the end of the desert and snow stages. Time each runner's leaps independently to get both characters through the course's challenges.

pages.title: Rocky the Jetpack Boy
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Rocky the Jetpack Boy follows Rocky through a side-scrolling endless adventure. Use the keyboard arrows or on-screen buttons to control the character's movement along the route. Keep the action going as you guide him farther through the scrolling course.

pages.title: Tangram
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Tangram challenges you to fill a target figure with differently shaped pieces. Drag each part into a position that fits the outline and works with its neighbors. Complete the arrangement to finish the level and continue to another shape puzzle.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Trials
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Dirt Bike Trials challenges you to complete every track as quickly as possible. Control the bike over each route's obstacles and keep the run moving toward the finish. Try both modes and compare the combined time recorded after all courses are completed.

pages.title: Street Fight King of the Gang
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Street Fight King of the Gang puts you against gang members in a series of punching contests. Use jabs, crosses, and uppercuts while dodging the attacks coming back. Knock out each opponent and adapt as the fighters grow harder to defeat.

pages.title: Princess Makeover
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Princess Makeover lets you change a princess's clothing and hairstyle. Browse the dress and hair categories, try different combinations, and choose the appearance you prefer. Complete the makeover by coordinating the outfit with the selected front and back hair options.

pages.title: Sky Warrior
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Sky Warrior sends your aircraft into battles against enemy planes and fighters. Move through the airspace, destroy opponents, and gather supplies including ammunition, fuel, missiles, and health. Collect stars and other improvements while keeping the plane in the aerial fight.

pages.title: Bmx Bike Freestyle & Racing
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Bmx Bike Freestyle & Racing combines city bike courses with freestyle tricks. Use flips, spins, and grinds to complete the levels, adjusting speed for the obstacles ahead. Control movement and jumps as you find a route through each urban riding challenge.

pages.title: Pixel Shot
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Pixel Shot is a shooting game where you move an armed character and fire at enemies. Use the movement controls to position the character and line up attacks. Eliminate opposing targets while handling the gunfire through the game's pixel-styled combat action.

pages.title: Flick Basketball
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Flick Basketball asks you to flick a ball into the hoop to score. Keep landing shots as the challenge becomes harder with a higher total. Collect stars for bonus points and try to improve the result from your latest basketball-shooting attempt.

pages.title: Flappy Cupid
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Flappy Cupid has you keep a small Cupid airborne by tapping the screen. Adjust the rhythm of your taps to pass obstacles without hitting them. Extend the flight as far as possible and try to beat the score from your previous attempt.

pages.title: Hill Climb Racing 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Hill Climb Racing 2 puts cars and bikes on routes with steep climbs and descents. Balance the vehicle through the changing terrain, collect coins, and perform tricks for bonuses. Use the earnings on upgrades that help you travel farther across the hills.

pages.title: Popular Wars
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Popular Wars turns gathering followers into a contest between roaming crowds. Collect neutral people around the map and take followers from rival players to eliminate them. Build a larger group and keep its leader moving through the arena to expand your following.

pages.title: Little Pony Caretaker
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Little Pony Caretaker asks you to help an exhausted Pegasus after its time caring for other animals. Wash away the dirt, treat the pony's wounds, and choose decorative clothing. Finish the care activities and styling to leave the winged pony refreshed.

pages.title: Sling Drift
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Sling Drift challenges you to guide a car around bends on an endless track. Trigger drifts with the left mouse button and time the turns to preserve its momentum. Keep the car from crashing while working toward a longer run through the course.

pages.title: Sisters School Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Sisters School Day helps Annie and Ellie prepare for the first day at their different schools. Choose a uniform for the younger sister and a suitable college outfit for the older one. Match each look to the requirements of the school she attends.

pages.title: Vehicles Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Vehicles Simulator is a driving game where you select a car and take it for a ride. Choose the vehicle you want to try and practice its handling during the driving session.

pages.title: Cartoon Cars Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cartoon Cars Coloring Book gives you illustrated vehicles to decorate. Select colors from the palette and fill the different areas of a car picture. Create your own combinations across the cartoon drawings and continue to another vehicle when the current artwork is finished.

pages.title: The Immersion
pages.creator: Pupgam Studios
pages.description: The Immersion challenges you to take a submarine deeper through a hazardous underwater route. Steer around the obstacles and keep clear of anything that could end the journey. Travel farther with each attempt as you work toward a better distance record.

pages.title: Boing Boing
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Boing Boing challenges you to make as many airborne twists as possible. Bounce the character upward and rotate during the jump to add turns. Keep working on the timing of the jumps and spins as you try to improve the score.

pages.title: Hardbounce
pages.creator: Seashine Games
pages.description: Hardbounce has you guide a bouncing ball through platforms and hazards. Keep it clear of spikes and flying obstacles, using the available bonuses when helpful. Continue the run to reach higher level targets without letting a collision end the attempt.

pages.title: Mini Race Rush
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Mini Race Rush mixes miniature-car racing with offensive power-ups. Blast, freeze, or shove opposing vehicles out of the way while driving through the competition. Unlock additional levels as you progress, with each new setting bringing a different car to use.

pages.title: Boat Battles
pages.creator: Whirlwind Games
pages.description: Boat Battles lets you arrange a fleet and play a Battleship-style contest against an opponent. Drag ships onto the grid and double-click to rotate them during setup. Once the boats are positioned, search the opposing grid and try to sink their fleet first.

pages.title: Mini Throat Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Mini Throat Doctor takes Mini to a clinic after a laboratory mix-up leaves him unwell. Examine his throat and work through the available treatment tools. Follow the care activities to discover the problem and help the character recover from the accident.

pages.title: Surround the Leprechaun
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Surround the Leprechaun challenges you to stop a crafty character escaping with a pot of gold. Place stones around his route and close the openings he could use. Plan each placement so the remaining gaps do not give the leprechaun a path away.

pages.title: Minions fly to NYC
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Minions fly to NYC helps a Minion prepare for a trip to New York. Decorate the suitcase with colors, tags, and stickers, then complete airport check-in. After arrival, choose a colorful outfit for the character's first day exploring the city.
